title: Self-assembled octanuclear [Ni5Ln3] (Ln = Dy, Tb and Ho) complexes: synthesis, coordination induced ligand hydrolysis, structure and magnetism

synthesis.procedure: General procedure for complexes 1–3: a MeOH solution (5 mL) of Ln(NO3)3·5H2O (0.05 mmol) was added dropwise into a stirred MeOH solution (10 mL) of H2L (0.03 g, 0.1 mmol), followed by dropwise addition of diluted NEt3 (0.02 g, 0.2 mmol). After 1 h of stirring, a MeOH solution (5 mL) of NiCl2·6H2O (0.024 g, 0.1 mmol) was added dropwise and the bright green mixture was stirred at room temperature for 12 h. The solution was filtered and left undisturbed for slow evaporation at room temperature. After one week, green crystalline powder was isolated and recrystallized from MeOH–CHCl3 (2:1), giving green needle-like crystals. For 1, Dy(NO3)3·5H2O was used.
synthesis.time: 1 h then 12 h stirring; 1 week crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly with stirring, filtration, slow evaporation, recrystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered and left undisturbed for slow evaporation; green crystalline powder recrystallized from MeOH–CHCl3 (2:1) to give green needles suitable for X-ray analysis

properties.summary: DC susceptibility (2–300 K, 1 kOe) shows a low-temperature χMT upturn consistent with ferromagnetic Ni···Dy interactions. M(H) does not saturate (2–10 K, 0–7 T); at 2 K and 7 T, M = 25.8 Nβ. AC susceptibility (3.5 Oe, 1–1.5 kHz, various DC fields) shows no out-of-phase signal, so 1 is not an SMM in the measured range. CASSCF/POLY_ANISO indicate axial Dy anisotropy but unfavourable easy-axis orientations and dipolar coupling promote QTM.
